description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring short forewing covers above full hindwings on a slender long-legged insect body.
description.zh: 拟议形态研究：细长长足虫体上短前翅覆盖完整后翅。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning study grounded in a named taxon source; reconstructed or simplified components remain artistic interpretations.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据具名分类单元来源进行属级规划；补全及简化结构仍属于复原或美术解释。

distinctness.en: A distinct construction based on short forewing covers above full hindwings on a slender long-legged insect body; not a size, color or posture variant.
distinctness.zh: 以细长长足虫体上短前翅覆盖完整后翅建立独立几何结构，而非尺寸、配色或姿势变体。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish short forewing covers above full hindwings on a slender long-legged insect body; emphasize the largest gaps and changes in contour. Simplify fine repeated surfaces; do not copy source geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先搭建细长长足虫体上短前翅覆盖完整后翅，突出主要间隙和轮廓变化，简化细小重复表面，不复制来源网格。

uncertainty: Named source supports the principal form. Species-level dimensions, missing structures and soft tissues still require a selected specimen reference.
reference_notes: Named concept revised during taxonomic and silhouette review. No exact coexistence is implied.

sources.title: New insect species Alienopterus brachyelytrus
sources.supports: Original paper abstract names genus Alienopterus, shortened forewings and functional hindwings; Cretaceous amber. DOI 10.1016/j.gr.2016.02.002.
